prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Spidops (트래피더) personified, bug type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her species shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never armor, never a creature costume. Era, place, activity, outfit, pose and camera follow SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; the Framing in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face. This crop wins over every other line — pose, outfit, props and activity details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. The lens sets perspective only, never how much of her shows. Do not widen the shot to fit them in. An arm or leg that crosses the edge runs naturally on past it — never cut off, shortened or fading out inside the image.

WORLD: this scene happens inside the Pokémon world, as if she simply lives there — its towns, routes, buildings, props, light and weather show the world. No Pokémon unless SCENE names her companion, no known trainers or characters, no logos, no text.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: her own room in a small house of a Pokémon-world town, a shelf of travel gear by the window
Activity: playing a game on the sofa with a controller in her hands
Outfit: A loose coral off-shoulder sleep shirt with a cropped hem above soft matching lounge shorts, exposing the shoulders and midriff.
Orientation: torso and pelvis face the camera; gaze is independent
Framing: Close-up of the face and hairstyle, preserving the approved facial identity and using only a subtle background.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
Expression: one mouth corner lifted, lids lowered in a knowing look, chin tipped slightly up
Scene note: A small matte game controller has rounded buttons; late-afternoon light catches a folded travel map on the low table.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more shoulder, neckline and upper-back exposure inside the crop; cover the chest
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
source_influence: balanced — her species shows as one accessory and one object in the scene; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; the part of that outfit inside the crop must read at first glance in its own colours. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands.

HAND TASK: her hands act naturally for the pose and scene; any idle hand rests in a relaxed, anatomically plausible position. Natural occlusion is allowed; do not force every hand or finger into view.
